PERSONAL POST✦FOR MANYA

To my favourite human,

HAPPIEST 18TH BIRTHDAYYYYY! ❤️

I wish I could be there today, annoying you, hugging you, celebrating with you and making sure you have the best birthday ever. It honestly feels a little unfair that I have to wish you from so far away, especially on such a special day. I miss you more than I can put into words, and I wish I could just skip the distance for a day and be right there with you.

But hey, don't you worry, okay? This distance is temporary, and I promise I'll be there soon. 20th November! Just a little longer, and I'll be back. And yes, your gift is waiting for you because I refuse to let you escape your birthday celebrations just because I couldn't be there on the actual day. We're going to make up for all the missed moments.

You know, one thing I'm genuinely so grateful for is this bond that we share. It's funny how some people become such an important part of your life, how they become your comfort, your constant, and someone you can always count on, even when life takes you to completely different places. I'm so happy that I have you. Through all the random conversations, endless gossip, silly moments, serious talks and everything in between, I wouldn't trade what we have for anything.

I hope 18 brings you everything your heart has been waiting for. I hope you grow into everything you've ever dreamed of becoming, find happiness in the smallest things, meet wonderful people, take chances, make memories and always remember how capable you are. I hope life is kind to you, but even when it isn't, I hope you never forget how loved and valued you are.

And please, never let the distance make you doubt how much you mean to me. Just because I'm not physically there doesn't mean I'm any less a part of your life. I'm always cheering for you, rooting for you and wishing the absolute best for you.

I love you SO MUCH. Thank you for being you, for being my person and for making this friendship something I can look back at and feel genuinely lucky about.

Here's to your adulthood, new beginnings, more memories, more laughter, more madness and a lifetime of friendship. This is just another chapter, and I can't wait for all the ones ahead of us.

Happy 18th once again, idiot. I miss you, I love you, and I'll see you on the 20th.. till then kindly avoid bakchodi hehe

With all my love,
Your favourite long-distance troublemaker ❤️

FROM STUTI, WITH LOVE♡18 LOOKS GOOD ON YOU
